subject: UefiCpuPkg/MpLib: Change print level for "5-Level Paging ="
reasons: Mechanical substitution of DEBUG_INFO with DEBUG_PAGING inside DEBUG() macro calls

Part of a larger series: neighbors include UefiCpuPkg/ArmMmuLib (e7ffbde9ad), UefiCpuPkg/CpuDxe (5dc31efc42), and OvmfPkg/BaseMemEncryptSevLib (3d6453f515) performing the identical DEBUG_VERBOSE->DEBUG_PAGING substitution across multiple packages
This commit substitutes DEBUG_INFO->DEBUG_PAGING for paging-related debug messages, same structural pattern as the series
The pattern is well-defined: replace the debug level argument in DEBUG() macro calls that relate to paging operations
candidate_pattern:
@@
expression msg;
@@
- DEBUG((DEBUG_INFO, msg, ...))
+ DEBUG((DEBUG_PAGING, msg, ...))
